# unifi_network_static_route (Resource)

A UniFi static route (`routing`, legacy `/rest`) — a user-defined route on the gateway: send traffic for a destination prefix via a next-hop gateway, out an interface, or to a blackhole.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Route name.
- `network` (String) Destination network in CIDR notation (e.g. `192.168.50.0/24`).

### Optional

- `distance` (Number) Administrative distance (route priority; lower wins). Defaults to `1`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `interface` (String) Egress interface. Used when `route_type = interface-route`.
- `next_hop` (String) Next-hop gateway IP. Required when `route_type = nexthop-route`.
- `route_type` (String) Route kind: `nexthop-route` (via `next_hop`), `interface-route` (out `interface`), or `blackhole` (drop). Defaults to `nexthop-route`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
